title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr Darcy trade sharp words and first impressions in a witty story about class, family and learning to look past pride.

author: George Orwell
description: Winston Smith lives under constant surveillance and rewritten history. A bleak, gripping warning about power and truth.

title: The Hobbit
author: J. R. R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins leaves his quiet hole in the ground to help a band of dwarves reclaim their mountain home from a dragon.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: Scout Finch grows up in a small Alabama town while her father defends a man falsely accused. A story about courage and conscience.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A shepherd boy travels from Spain to the Egyptian desert in search of treasure and learns to follow his personal calling.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A sweeping history of humankind, from early foragers to modern societies, asking how stories and cooperation shaped our world.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones through small changes that compound over time.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: Narrator Nick Carraway watches his mysterious neighbour chase a lost love in the glittering, hollow Jazz Age.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: Black holes, the Big Bang and the nature of time explained for curious readers without a physics degree.

title: Wings of Fire
author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
description: The autobiography of the scientist and former President of India, from a modest childhood in Rameswaram to India's space and missile programmes.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: Principles and worked examples for writing readable, maintainable software that other developers will thank you for.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer
author: Andrew Hunt and David Thomas
description: Timeless, hands-on advice on craft, tools and habits for anyone who writes code for a living.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
author: J. K. Rowling
description: An orphan discovers he is a wizard and starts at Hogwarts, where friendship and a hidden stone change his life.

title: Gitanjali
author: Rabindranath Tagore
description: A collection of devotional poems that earned Tagore the Nobel Prize in Literature, quiet and luminous.

title: The Murder of Roger Ackroyd
author: Agatha Christie
description: Hercule Poirot investigates a murder in a quiet English village, in a mystery famous for its twist ending.

title: Cosmos
author: Carl Sagan
description: A tour through the universe and the history of scientific thinking, told with wonder and clarity.
